sections.h2: Exterior failures we see around Fort White
body: On riverfront lots near Ichetucknee and in Three Rivers Estates, exterior paint usually fails from moisture. Green film forms on north walls, paint blisters where siding never fully dries, and soffits get soft under thick tree cover. On ranch properties, it fails from sun: chalky south walls, cracked caulk, and trim that has split and lost its coating. Exterior painting in Fort White, FL needs a prep plan that deals with the actual cause, not just a fresh color.

Paint applied over damp wood will blister and peel, no matter the brand. On shaded homes, the crew lead takes moisture readings on suspect siding and trim during the walkthrough and again before priming. Boards that read wet and stay soft are replaced. The washing step includes a mildew treatment that kills growth at the root. A pressure rinse alone just moves it around. Our soft washing in Fort White page explains the cleaning side.

bullets: Scrape to a sound edge and sand glossy areas
Rot and fascia replacement, nail pops reset
Two coats of 100% acrylic, back-brushed where sprayed
body: Siding and trim get 100% acrylic, which breathes and flexes. Any stucco with hairline movement gets elastomeric. Front doors and railings get a waterborne urethane enamel. The product line is named on your estimate so the manufacturer's warranty can be enforced. For more on why wet climates are hard on paint, read how Florida weather affects house painting.

The best window is October through May. Shaded walls dry slowly after a storm, so crews may start on the sunny sides in the morning and move to the shaded ones once they are dry. In summer, work starts early and crews keep an eye on dew point and radar. A full exterior usually takes three to seven working days, plus washing and dry time. If you are changing colors, start with a color consultation in Fort White so the palette is set before the schedule is. Our main exterior painting page covers the full process, and the Fort White overview lists our other local services.

faqs.q: Why does paint peel faster on my shaded Fort White home?
faqs.a: Shaded walls stay damp longer, so mildew grows and moisture gets behind the film. Killing growth, checking moisture, and replacing wet wood before painting addresses the cause.

faqs.q: When is the best time to paint an exterior in Fort White?
faqs.a: October through May. Summer projects start early in the day and depend on dew point and radar.

faqs.q: Do you paint commercial buildings on Main Street?
faqs.a: Yes. Commercial exteriors are scheduled around business hours, including nights and weekends when needed.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with an exterior repaint?
faqs.a: A written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, on top of the manufacturer's product warranty.
